text: Only the person who has experienced light and darkness, war and peace, rise and fall, only that person has truly experienced life.
author: Stefan Zweig

archive.text: The greatest discovery of our generation is that human beings can alter their lives by altering their attitudes of mind. As you think, so shall you be.
archive.author: William James

archive.text: Poverty is the worst form of violence.
archive.author: Mahatma Gandhi

archive.text: Anger, if not restrained, is frequently more hurtful to us than the injury that caused it.
archive.author: Seneca

archive.text: I have never tried that before, so I think I should definitely be able to do that.
archive.author: Astrid Lindgren

archive.text: When something is important enough, you do it even if the odds are not in your favor.
archive.author: Elon Musk

archive.text: The Way of strategy is the Way of nature. When you appreciate the power of nature, knowing the rhythm of any situation, you will be able to hit the enemy naturally and strike naturally.
archive.author: Miyamoto Musashi
